verdict: Microsoft's revenue rose 17% to $81.3B as its cloud business passed $50B in a quarter for the first time — and a $7.6B gain on its OpenAI stake lifted headline profit 60%.

segments.name: Productivity and Business Processes
segments.note: Microsoft 365 for businesses (commercial cloud +17%), LinkedIn (+11%) and Dynamics 365 (+19%) — the software businesses sell to companies.

segments.name: Intelligent Cloud
segments.note: Azure cloud computing and server products; Azure revenue grew 39% as AI demand kept building.

segments.name: More Personal Computing
segments.note: Windows licences, Xbox, Surface devices and search ads. The only shrinking piece: Windows OEM was flat (+1%) and Xbox content and services fell 5%.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building new products and AI; up 7% YoY.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The sales force and marketing; up 2% YoY.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Back-office and legal costs; up 6% YoY.

otherDetail: Mostly net gains on Microsoft's investment in OpenAI, which added $7,583M to net income after tax. Microsoft's non-GAAP figures strip this gain out.
follow100Note: The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: The cloud crossed $50B
takeaways.text: Microsoft Cloud revenue was $51.5B, up 26%, and Azure grew 39%. Customers have committed to a record $625B of future spending (commercial remaining performance obligation, +110%).

takeaways.title: Headline profit is flattered by OpenAI
takeaways.text: GAAP net income jumped 60% to $38.5B, but $7.6B of it was a paper gain on the OpenAI investment. Excluding that (non-GAAP), profit was $30.9B, up 23%, and EPS was $4.14 rather than $5.16.

takeaways.title: The consumer side shrank
takeaways.text: More Personal Computing — Windows, Xbox, Surface and search ads — fell 3% to $14.3B, the only declining piece, while the two business segments grew 16% and 29%.

oneTimers: Net gains from investments in OpenAI increased GAAP net income by $7,583M ($1.02 per share). Non-GAAP net income excluding the OpenAI impact was $30,875M ($4.14 per share), up 23%.
